scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @smartserve/web && npm run build --workspace @smartserve/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @smartserve/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @smartserve/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @smartserve/api
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build --workspace @smartserve/web && wrangler pages deploy apps/web/dist --project-name smartserve
